Hi Simen,
As we already aligned, I would suggest one last trial before replacing the router.
In other countries we are facing the same issue and what we usually do is, fit a piece of paper in the SIM to create better contact with the magnetic reader.
If after doing this, it won't work, then please replace the Router.
I will send to your queue.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
